Requirement: The system shall autonomously detect a commanded AprilTag and head toward it without operator piloting.
Pass_Criterion: Vehicle reaches ACHIEVED autonomously, unpiloted.

Requirement: The system shall reduce range to the commanded tag at a measurable nonzero rate under nominal conditions.
Tool: onboard apriltag log + overhead phone camera
Pass_Criterion: Range decreases monotonically; mean closure rate > 0 recorded.

Requirement: The system shall operate submerged to a maximum depth of 0.75 m.
Pass_Criterion: Operates at 0.75 m; no ingress (per VER-004).

Requirement: The system shall remain watertight with zero ingress for the mission duration at <= 0.75 m.
Pass_Criterion: Zero water/dye on the interior witness.

Requirement: The system shall accept missions and report status through the operator console.
Pass_Criterion: Mission accepted and status reported.

Requirement: The system shall be safe to retrieve by hand from the water at any time, presenting no shock, burn, or high-energy pinch hazard.
Pass_Criterion: No net-to-water continuity; surface touch-safe; retrievable by hand/pole.

Requirement: The system shall reliably detect a 200 mm tag36h11 AprilTag at ranges >= 1.5 m under nominal lighting.
Tool: tape measure + 200 mm waterproof tag on stand + onboard log
Pass_Criterion: Reliable detection at >= 1.5 m.

Requirement: The system shall declare a homing mission ACHIEVED when range to the commanded tag is <= 0.30 m and bearing is aligned.
Pass_Criterion: Range <= 0.30 m at ACHIEVED.

Requirement: The system shall autonomously search (sweep) for the commanded tag when it is not initially within the camera field of view.
Tool: kinematic Gazebo (tag in world) or onboard logs + overhead camera
Pass_Criterion: Vehicle finds a tag not initially visible.

Requirement: On no measurable progress toward the commanded tag, the system shall auto-retry up to a configured limit and then escalate to the operator.
Tool: kinematic Gazebo or host-side + onboard logs
Pass_Criterion: No-progress detected; retries then escalates; no erratic motion.

Requirement: The system shall accept a FIFO queue of tag missions and support priority missions that preempt or reorder the running mission, with a configurable wait timeout before preemption.
Pass_Criterion: Queue executes in order; override preempts per the timeout.

Requirement: The system shall be slightly negatively buoyant, resting on the pool floor when unpowered, and shall be retrievable by hand or pole from <= 0.75 m.
Tool: digital scale + hanging/spring scale + calibration weights + pool
Pass_Criterion: F_b < W_air (net negative); vehicle sinks slowly, rests on floor, retrievable.

Requirement: The system shall sustain at least 30 minutes of continuous autonomous operation per deployment.
Pass_Criterion: >= 30 min continuous; clean low-voltage handling.

Requirement: The system shall navigate to a defined home position (pool centre) using AprilTag bearing and range within the known, measured pool.
Tool: onboard logs + overhead camera + tape-marked pool centre
Pass_Criterion: Vehicle reaches home (pool centre) within tolerance.

Requirement: The system shall not actuate any propulsor during a configurable startup settling period (default 10 s) after power-on.
Tool: host-side / kinematic sim + onboard joint_cmd log
Pass_Criterion: No propulsor motion until the settle period (default 10 s) elapses.

Requirement: On loss of a sensor input or an internal fault, the system shall transition to a stable hover (HOVERING) rather than continue an uncommanded manoeuvre.
Pass_Criterion: Vehicle enters stable hover; no uncommanded manoeuvre.

Requirement: The system shall clamp every propulsor command to its configured mechanical limits before output.
Pass_Criterion: No joint_cmd ever exceeds the configured min/max.

Requirement: The system shall reject malformed mission, configuration, or detection messages without crashing and without commanding the propulsors.
Pass_Criterion: Nodes log an error, keep running, and issue no propulsor command from bad input.

Requirement: The system shall ignore target detections older than a configured age and shall not act on stale perception data.
Pass_Criterion: Controller does not act on stale detections (treats as no-detection).

Requirement: The system shall command the propulsors only after receiving the latched robot configuration (correct actuator mapping).
Pass_Criterion: No propulsor command issued until the latched configuration is received.

Requirement: The vehicle dry mass shall be 1-3 kg (recorded by weigh-in) to meet the buoyancy/ballast budget.
Pass_Criterion: Dry mass within 1-3 kg; value recorded.

Requirement: The fins shall be Garolite reinforced with a carbon-fiber rod, with interchangeable surfaces (Icarex+PVA aerial / nylon+steel underwater).
Pass_Criterion: Materials and reinforcement as specified.

Requirement: The aluminum enclosure shall be sealed watertight with silicone at the lid/seams and cord grips at every cable penetration (strain-relieved).
Pass_Criterion: Continuous silicone seal; all penetrations via sealed cord grips.

Requirement: The vehicle shall be powered by a 3S LiPo (~2200 mAh) supplying separate servo and compute rails.
Pass_Criterion: Correct pack; two rails present.

Requirement: Battery voltage shall not be driven below the LiPo safe cutoff (~9.0 V / 3.0 V per cell); operation below shall trigger a warning or safe shutdown.
Pass_Criterion: Warning or shutdown before voltage falls below ~9.0 V.

Requirement: Each servo's current limit shall be configured (factory default) and the peak per-servo current recorded and within safe thermal range.
Tool: digital multimeter (in series) or servo current telemetry
Pass_Criterion: Peak per-servo current recorded; limit holds on stall; no overheating.

Requirement: All wiring shall show end-to-end continuity < 1 ohm, no unintended shorts, and intact insulation with no exposed conductors reachable when wet.
Pass_Criterion: Continuity < 1 ohm; no shorts; no exposed conductors.

Requirement: All four servos shall enumerate and respond on the RS-485 bus (Dynamixel Protocol 2.0).
Pass_Criterion: 4/4 servos enumerate on RS-485.

Requirement: The system shall reduce range to the commanded tag at a measurable nonzero rate under nominal conditions.
Pass_Criterion: Waveforms stay within [center +/- amplitude]; symmetric; sweep matches the specified profile.

Requirement: The system shall autonomously detect a commanded AprilTag and head toward it without operator piloting.
Pass_Criterion: Every transition fires only under its documented condition; no illegal transitions.

Requirement: The system shall clamp every propulsor command to its configured mechanical limits before output.
Pass_Criterion: Output is clamped to [min,max] for every input; never exceeds limits.

Requirement: The system shall ignore target detections older than a configured age and shall not act on stale perception data.
Pass_Criterion: Detections older than the window are treated as no-detection.

Requirement: The system shall command the propulsors only after receiving the latched robot configuration (correct actuator mapping).
Pass_Criterion: No command produced pre-config; commands produced post-config.

Requirement: The system shall accept a FIFO queue of tag missions and support priority missions that preempt or reorder the running mission, with a configurable wait timeout before preemption.
Pass_Criterion: Queue order preserved; retries capped; priority preempts; timeout advances.

Requirement: The system shall reliably detect a 200 mm tag36h11 AprilTag at ranges >= 1.5 m under nominal lighting.
Pass_Criterion: Computed range/bearing match the analytic values within tolerance.

Requirement: The system shall reject malformed mission, configuration, or detection messages without crashing and without commanding the propulsors.
Pass_Criterion: Parsers raise/return cleanly; never yield an actuation command.

Requirement: The system shall declare a homing mission ACHIEVED when range to the commanded tag is <= 0.30 m and bearing is aligned.
Pass_Criterion: ACHIEVED only when range <= 0.30 m and bearing aligned.

Requirement: The system shall not actuate any propulsor during a configurable startup settling period (default 10 s) after power-on.
Pass_Criterion: Command path suppressed during settle; active after.
